text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of features and user stories describing what users need. Every day, the team meets for a quick standup to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver small parts of the product regularly, get feedback, and improve step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams stay flexible and respond quickly to change.
